title: Relating locus
description: JSON Schema for the object-coordinate R of the originating cell φ* = (X, p*, R). There is exactly one instance: the entity-slug 'relating-locus' itself, the canonical object-coordinate of the originating cell. The schema admits a single const entity-slug value; the slug is the entity's name.

name.description: The entity-slug naming the relating-locus. Only one instance is admissible: the canonical object-coordinate of φ*.
